fusions.name: Carving Stroke
fusions.desc: A carver's cut that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Shared Table
fusions.desc: Deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Passing Plates
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, every heal reaching you is worth 30% more for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
